description: This file contains utility functions for Wi-Fi management, including channel validation, parsing scan bands, SSIDs, and channels, specific to the Zephyr RTOS Wi-Fi subsystem.

methods.name: wifi_utils_map_band_str_to_idx
methods.description: Maps band string ('2', '5', '6') to enum wifi_frequency_bands.

methods.name: wifi_utils_validate_chan_2g
methods.description: Validates if a channel is within 2.4 GHz band (1-14).

methods.name: wifi_utils_validate_chan_5g
methods.description: Validates if a channel is within 5 GHz band based on predefined valid channels.

methods.name: wifi_utils_validate_chan_6g
methods.description: Validates if a channel is within 6 GHz band (1-233, with specific rules).

methods.name: wifi_utils_get_all_chans_in_range
methods.description: Populates band_chan array with channels in a specified range for a given band.

methods.name: wifi_utils_validate_chan_str
methods.description: Checks if a channel string contains only digits and is non-empty.

methods.name: wifi_utils_parse_scan_bands
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of bands into a bitmask.

methods.name: wifi_utils_parse_scan_ssids
methods.description: Parses SSID strings from input and stores them in provided array.

methods.name: wifi_utils_parse_scan_chan
methods.description: Parses a complex channel string into a list of band-channel structures.
